verdict.rationale: The main uspto.gov guidance pages (trademarks/apply, patents/apply/patent-center, fees-and-payment, application-timeline) were evidently retrieved with readable text. Probes against uspto.gov returned ordinary HTTP 404s rather than a bot wall or CAPTCHA. However, the developer portal at developer.uspto.gov serves a JavaScript-only app shell, so its API documentation is not readable by a plain keyless fetch. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 with a standard identified user agent on the guidance pages, explicit confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot challenge appears, and server-rendered developer/API documentation.
